result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the 'Popular right now' restaurant card has a broken title/rating layout, and there are minor styling inconsistencies between cards.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character where it collides with the right-aligned rating ('4.8 (500+)'). This is a full-width vertical list card, so the title should not be truncated abruptly without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with the rating as a fixed-width sibling, and apply text-overflow: ellipsis so long names truncate gracefully with adequate gap from the rating.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles — the first has a white/light circular background while the second has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, border and icon color across all cards.

issues.description: The first card in 'Fastest near you' (Green Bowl Poké) has a light gray image background while the neighboring cards use dark imagery, creating an inconsistent visual rhythm in the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment (e.g., uniform overlay/gradient) so all carousel thumbnails have similar tone and the white time badge remains legible.

issues.description: The white '15–25 min' badge on the light gray Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has low contrast against its background, making the badge edge hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow/border to badges or darken the image overlay to guarantee badge separation on light images.
